scenes.quote: Did you do, uh, keyword research before this, or no?
reasons: Scene record; not scored at extraction (E.B12)
scenes.proposition: Carmen Cruickshank noticed: Said the visible searches appeared to include general venue terms and that she did not see many corporate-specific terms. | Carmen Cruickshank asked: Asked whether Erin had done keyword research before setting up the campaign. | Carmen Cruickshank recommended: Suggested a branded campaign as a possible way to increase bookings generally, and added the keyword “event venue Brooklyn” to the campaign. | Client: Erin said about 80% of the venue’s business was weddings, that she had used keywords researched for a corporate campaign from two years earlier, and that she had created separate keywords rather than reusing the wedding keywords. | Left open: Carmen said she was unsure whether general venue searches had wedding or corporate intent.; No decision was made about adding a branded campaign.
qualifications: The suggested cost per lead from a branded campaign was an estimate stated by Carmen, not a measured result.
scenes.context_summary: Carmen reviews the searches and keywords associated with the corporate campaign. She says she sees general event-venue searches more often than corporate-specific searches.
scenes.audience_relevance: Not assessed at extraction; the strategist judges relevance (E.B12)
